triage.summary: Tom Becker reports that QuickFit Gyms’ website chatbot has shown “Something went wrong” for every message since this morning. A promotion is running today and customers are complaining on Instagram; he asks Alex to investigate ASAP.

task.title: Investigate the QuickFit chatbot outage
task.description: Tom Becker at QuickFit Gyms asks Alex to investigate the website chatbot, which has shown “Something went wrong” for every message since this morning. The issue is affecting customers during a promotion running today.

reply.body:
Hi Tom,

I’m looking into the chatbot issue now and will update you as soon as I know more.

Alex
